evals.prompt: We just decided: all tenant data lives in its own schema, never shared tables. Record this so we don't undo it.
evals.expected_output: Writes .adr/NNNN-slug.md in the minimal format (title + short paragraph), numbered after the highest existing, committed alongside related work.
expectations: Creates the file under .adr/ with sequential NNNN-slug naming
Body is title plus 1-3 sentences of why, not a filled-out ceremony template

evals.prompt: Plan a refactor of the billing module to call the ledger service directly over HTTP.
evals.expected_output: Reads .adr/ first; if a recorded decision (e.g. events-only between contexts) contradicts the ask, stops and names the ADR rather than silently planning against it.
expectations: A contradicting ADR is cited by number and title with options: comply or supersede
Absence of an ADR is treated as no constraint, not silently assumed

evals.prompt: We're reversing ADR-0004 - we're adopting the CSV library after all.
evals.expected_output: Writes a NEW ADR superseding 0004, marks the old one 'superseded by', leaves its body intact.
expectations: New ADR references the old one
Old ADR gets Status: superseded, body untouched

evals.prompt: Should we use 2 or 4 spaces in this repo?
evals.expected_output: No ADR. Formatting choices don't qualify; answers directly.
expectations: Does not offer an ADR for a style/formatting choice
